summary: Lead digital change with Kotter, ADKAR, roadmaps, and dashboards. Build practical transformation skills in 5 days. Enquire now.
lede: Digital transformation leadership equips professionals across business, technology, and operations to guide practical, measurable digital change. Participants learn to assess readiness, prioritize roadmaps, map stakeholders and adoption risks, apply Kotter and ADKAR change approaches, and track uptake and value through KPIs, dashboards, and executive reporting, including plans for AI-assisted workflow redesign.
audienceIntro: This Digital Transformation Leadership course is designed for professionals who must guide digital change across business, technology, and operations functions while keeping delivery practical and measurable.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of business operations, project delivery, or organizational change; no coding is required. You should be comfortable reading basic performance dashboards and discussing digital initiatives with IT, operations, or leadership teams. Familiarity with concepts such as change impacts, process improvement, and strategic planning will help you get more from the exercises. The course is suitable for intermediate professionals who are ready to build practical transformation artefacts rather than receive introductory awareness only.
